contents: # The addresses uhifadhi/area-module owns: the register, the create screen, one
# area's overview, its module grid and shop, its zones and its settings.
# A MODULE MAY SHIP ROUTES — only the shell may not. The controllers carry their
# own #[Route] attributes; this file is where your application mounts them, and
# it is yours: prefix them, restrict them, or point somewhere else entirely.
# THE ROUTE NAMES MATTER. The sidebar section and the area tab strip generate
# `area_settings`, and both are route-tolerant: unmount one and its row or tab
# simply does not appear, rather than every page failing. That is deliberate, so
# removing a screen is a supported thing to do and not a way to break the frame.
# `seam_area_modules` IS A FLEET NAME, not this module's. Other module bundles
# generate it blind to link back to the area's module grid — the patrol module's
# breadcrumb does — and print plain text where nothing answers. Renaming it here
# is supported and costs you those links; the pages themselves stay reachable.
